card.name: Do-not limits on storage time
card.fires_on: The word right after a negated storage or handling instruction (do not leave, should not be stored), where a time or amount limit like "for more than" or "longer than" comes next.

modes.label: "for" before a time limit
modes.description: The word "for" after a negated hold or store verb, leading into "more than X hours".
modes.example: The diluted solution should not be stored<< for>> more than 4 hours at controlled room

modes.label: Other words before a limit
modes.description: A verb or noun after a negation, followed by a cap such as "longer than" or "by more than".
modes.example: Do not leave these vials at room<< temperature>> longer than 24 hours prior to

card.writes: It pushes toward words of excess or limits like "too much", "too long" and "anything", and away from words meaning appropriate or suitable.
card.plain: It fires in warnings that say not to keep or store something past a set time or amount.
